description: The plot illustrates the loss of different SepLLM models and a vanilla model before post-training over a range of iterations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, ranges from 90000 to 130000, and has tick labels at intervals of 5000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", has a linear scale, and ranges from 2.0 to 3.0 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot includes four lines: a magenta solid line representing SepLLM (n=64, larger lr) with a loss of approximately 2.95 at 90000 iterations and 2.25 at 125000 iterations, decreasing steadily; a blue solid line representing SepLLM (n=128) with a loss of approximately 2.9 at 90000 iterations and 2.35 at 125000 iterations, also decreasing steadily; an orange solid line representing SepLLM (n=64) with a loss of approximately 3.0 at 90000 iterations and 2.4 at 125000 iterations, decreasing steadily; and a red dashed line representing Vanilla before post-training with a constant loss of approximately 2.35 across the entire range of iterations.
